title: Wavelength calculation
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the wavelength using λ = c / f, yielding 8000 m.

title: Resonance capacitance formula
description: Important: The response must apply the LC resonance formula f = 1 / (2π√(LC)) or its rearrangement.

title: Capacitance calculation
description: Essential: The response must correctly compute the capacitance, yielding 4.5 × 10⁻⁹ F (or 4.5 nF).

title: Unit consistency
description: Important: All calculations must use consistent SI units (Hz for frequency, H for inductance, m/s for c).

title: Incorrect frequency conversion
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the frequency is not converted from kHz to Hz (37.5 kHz = 37500 Hz).

title: Formula misapplication
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the wrong resonance formula (e.g., f = 1/(LC)) is used, or if π is omitted.

title: Unit omission or error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if final answers lack correct units (m, F) or have incorrect unit prefixes.

title: Alternative derivation
description: Optional: Award credit for a clear derivation showing the rearrangement of the resonance formula.
